title: Region-gated multi-marketplace launch: SKU mapping, telemetry gates, and canonical release notes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate listing updates and release notes across AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and Google Cloud Marketplace with a region-gated rollout plan. This ticket owns SKU/entitlement mapping, canonicalized release notes for partner portals, telemetry gating criteria (error/latency/cost), and the cross-functional checklist to release to additional geographies. Goals: reduce post-launch rollback risk, provide a single source of truth for release notes and legal artifacts, and ensure billing entitlements match product subscriptions for Dedicated and Private customers.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical release notes document created and approved by Legal and Docs
SKU mapping table completed for AWS/Azure/GCP and validated against Finance billing sheet
Region gating thresholds defined and implemented in Canary telemetry dashboard
Marketplace assets (icons, screenshots, legal text) uploaded to all three portals for initial regions
Launch checklist signed off by PM, Eng on-call, Growth, and Partnerships
Rollback playbook and customer communications template reviewed and stored in Confluence
steps: Draft canonical release notes and share with Docs + Legal for review (confluence link in links)
Consolidate SKU and entitlement mapping: map product SKUs to marketplace SKUs and Pricing SKUs
Coordinate with Finance to validate metering/entitlement behavior for Dedicated customers
Implement telemetry gates: define thresholds for error rate, p50/p95 latency, and token-cost per request
Create Canary in 2-3 pilot regions (us-west1, eu-west1) and configure automatic gating to block further regions
Stage assets upload: partner tile, screenshots, feature bullets, and localized summaries
Prepare release notes for each marketplace portal (formatting and max char limits differ) and submit for partner review
Confirm marketplace legal artifacts (MOU/license text) are included and have Legal signoff
Run a dry-run internal launch with Growth + Support to validate entitlement flows and purchase-to-provision path
Coordinate go/no-go 24 hours before regional expansion and run post-launch monitoring for 72 hours
risks: SKU mismatch causing incorrect billing for early customers
Marketplace listing formatting limits (character/feature bullet caps) lead to truncated messaging
Telemetry gating misconfiguration could prematurely block rollout or fail to catch regressions
Legal artifacts delays (procurement/partner legal) push marketplace submission windows
Private/Dedicated entitlement edge-cases not covered by standard marketplace metering
